count_reason: Eight groups cover the user's named hazards. Wind, gusts and edges are the harshest and widest, so they get most worlds. Friction, heat and dust get fewer. Total is 52, below the cap of 60.

groups.name: High steady wind
groups.reason: Tall towers see strong sustained wind; tests tether and suction hold. Height-based wind profile itself not tested.

groups.name: Strong gusts on high facade
groups.reason: Gusts at height can peel or swing the robot; varies speed, timing and direction.

groups.name: Dust on glass and seal
groups.reason: Sandstorm: dust load on glass and leak tested; airborne sand hitting sensors and pads not tested.

groups.name: Wet humid low friction glass
groups.reason: High moisture and humidity lower friction; rain itself not tested, only wet glass.

groups.name: Dry high friction glass
groups.reason: Changes humidity_pct, pad_force_n, wetness only. Dust on the glass not tested.

groups.name: Weird edges and joints
groups.reason: Odd edges, proud mullions, wide joint gaps and ledges can break seal or block travel.

groups.name: Extreme heat with weak battery
groups.reason: Very hot air stresses battery and suction; low start charge tests return margin.

groups.name: Weak suction with wind
groups.reason: Reduced suction and leaky seal combined with strong wind on a high, smooth facade.

not_tested.reason: No physics for sand hitting sensors, pads or impeller; only dust on glass is tested.

not_tested.factor: Building height and wind by height
not_tested.reason: Wind does not scale with height; tall-tower wind is mimicked only with high wind and tether drop.
Heat is tested as air and battery temperature only; solar heating of glass and sensor glare are not modelled.
Only the simulated robot is tested, not real motors, sensors or tether wear.

not_tested.factor: Rain, ice and snow, salt corrosion
not_tested.reason: No physics for these; wet glass only approximates moisture.
